name: InvoGenix
summary: Automating clinical documentation and billing for small practices
title: Co-Founder and Chief Executive Officer
bullets: Leads a four-person team building an end-to-end system that automates clinical documentation and billing for small and independent practices using natural language processing and a clinical knowledge graph.
Secured approximately $45,000 in non-dilutive funding; selected for iVenture Accelerator in a cohort of fewer than fifteen ventures.
Placed fourth at the Global Consortium of Innovation and Engineering in Medicine international competition.
Designed and launched a live clinical pilot; directed product discovery across forty-plus clinician interviews.
